component.name: Chrono FTP
component.summary: Copy files between your computer and your servers

description.p: Chrono FTP is a free program for Linux that copies files between your computer and your servers. Your computer is always on the left and your server on the right, so you always know where you are looking, and you copy files by dragging them from one side to the other.

Every connection can have a colour of its own. While you are connected, the right-hand side and the tab of that connection show that colour, so you can keep several servers open at the same time, each with its own folders, and still see at a glance which one you are working on.

It works with servers over SSH and over FTP. Copying runs in a queue you can watch, pause and stop. Renaming, moving, copying, deleting and changing permissions happen on the server itself, so files are not sent to your computer and back for no reason.
